**Finding: compliant (preferred position) — no redline proposed.**

Rule LD asks whether the Client is exposed to liquidated damages or penalties. It is not:

- **§ 5a / § 6 (Compensation):** only ordinary fees per Exhibits A and B plus in-term monthly minimums — these are subscription minimums during the term, not sums triggered by termination or breach.
- **§ 13 / § 14 (Term and Termination):** termination operates purely on notice, with services continuing to the last day of the month following notice. There is no early-termination fee, minimum-term buyout, or acceleration of remaining contract value.
- **§ 7 / § 8f (Unsolicited Commercial E-Mail / Spamming):** the common per-message penalty pattern is absent; TrueLink reserves only technical measures and its general legal and equitable rights.
- **§ 12 (Liability/Indemnity):** the monetary cap runs against TrueLink, i.e. in our favour, so it is not flagged.

Targeted searches for "liquidated", "penalty", "damages", "forfeit", "stipulated" and all fee/charge language surfaced no Client-payable stipulated amount, so the fallback (a 3-month-capped early-termination fee) is not even engaged. The preferred position is met as drafted; the only point worth monitoring commercially is the blank minimum monthly figures in § 5a and the § 14 cross-reference to "Section 4," which is the Support Services clause — neither creates a liquidated damages exposure under this rule.
